sets.name: set 1
sets.description: The first eight queries: the frog, stock, bank and tariff stories, asked directly and in other words.

queries.text: frog jump
amphibian leaping onto wood
the toad hopped by a tree trunk
frog refused to jump
prices jumped after earnings
central bank raises interest rates
Is the company being hurt by import duties?
customs levies refunded

sets.name: set 2
sets.description: Eleven harder queries, written after set 1 with less overlap in wording with the originals, plus wrong-polarity and wrong-sense distractors. No parameter was tuned on it, but it was written knowing the corpus, so read it as "harder", not as an independent benchmark.

queries.text: a small green animal climbed onto a piece of timber at sunrise
the creature hid from the bird and would not move
costs went up because of new levies on foreign goods
did the firm get money back from customs authorities
lender raises borrowing costs to fight rising prices
something took off and went into space
baking a loaf at home
pet went missing and a kid brought it back
walking to the top of a hill and sheltering in a cabin
an amphibian stayed still because a predator was nearby
toad resting at the edge of a stream

sets.name: set 3
sets.description: Nine queries about the stories added after the first eleven. Near-misses are the point: shipping costs are not import duties, a night watchman's "duties" are not import duties, village "customs" are not customs levies.

queries.text: did the company suffer a cyberattack?
who will replace the chief executive?
ships stuck at port pushing up freight costs
management lowered its outlook for the year
how much was the patent lawsuit settled for?
the lender set aside money for bad loans
what were the night watchman's responsibilities?
what traditions does the village keep at its harvest festival?
the company will buy back its own stock
